title: feat: Community page from website v2
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Part of #14472 — brings Elliot's v2 Community page to main.

- Adds four ways to contribute, each with a live count: listed apps, community models and agents, merged PRs, people online in Discord
- Loads open votes live from GitHub (`[Voting Issue]` title marker) instead of hard-coded counts
- Moves the Quest leaderboard to v2 copy with loading and error states, on the shared loader from #16185
- Adds top contributors and v2's 12 supporters
- Drops the build diary entirely, plus the code it alone used (translation copy, the text-API summarizer and 10 unused logos)

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Hero | Fixed 17K / 4K / 500+ numbers | "Community", no numbers |
| Votes | 3 frozen counts | Live from GitHub |
| Diary | Daily cards, summarized with the visitor's key | Removed |

Checked: tsc, 67 tests, build, desktop and mobile screenshots with live data and no horizontal scroll.
